body:
`POST /tasks` with a `milestone` returns the task with `milestone: null`; a `PATCH` afterwards sets it. Creating a task keeps the `milestone` it was given.

`board::task_model.created` reads only `title`, `body`, `links` and `scope` from the request, so `feature` and `dependsOn` are likely dropped the same way: keep those too, checked as a `PATCH` checks them (an unknown record is refused, not saved).

**Tests:** a task created with a milestone, a feature and a dependency returns and stores all three; an unknown one is refused.
title: tasks: keep milestone on create
